title: Clarification requests in a fictional guide trial
method: Three readers try a six-step guide and raise nine clarification requests. Categories contain 4 + 3 + 2 requests. These are request counts, not unique people or a generalised usability rate.
alt: Clarification requests in a fictional guide trial. Prerequisites: 4 requests; File paths: 3 requests; Expected output: 2 requests. Illustrative inputs.
